reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 16. Nay or No: 22. Not Voting: 2. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
In 2008, working people lost their homes and jobs while big banks got bailed out.

Now Wall Street's former top regulator says the AI bubble is likely to burst before 2028.

My resolution with @RepMaxineWaters draws a hard line: no bailouts for AI billionaires. https://t.co/eW6dgPudi0

AI execs say their tech can cure all cancer, but they can’t imagine nations signing a diplomatic agreement?

Countries have done it before. We must do it again.

End the AI arms race. https://t.co/MmMTmq830X

Ban Super PACs.

Billionaires shouldn’t get to buy our elections.

Leader Jeffries is pushing getting many millions more people the healthcare they need this year. 

This dramatic Medicare expansion is the Year 1 plan that incoming Health Chairman @SenSanders is pushing. 

Step by step we will march toward healthcare as a human right and replace our broken, profit driven system.
Austinites voted for light rail in 2020. Now the city is starting the work to run the train all the way to the airport. Let’s get it built! https://t.co/COIlWjyIAv

Voters just sent a clear message: a few AI billionaires shouldn’t get to decide whether you keep your job, or whether we survive as a species.

We all should have a say, not just the billionaires. https://t.co/PHtsT8wJqE

Thank you, veterans.

Our country can never forget the service and sacrifice of every American who wore the uniform.

If you need assistance getting the benefits you earned, my office is ready to help.

Nikki Budzinski and I both started our careers in the labor movement. In Congress, we’ve become colleagues and friends.

We chair caucuses with different perspectives, but I’m looking forward to working with her to deliver for working families. https://t.co/M7nbV7rNnS
Impeach Pete Hegseth. https://t.co/nTjbK6WSnj

APPLY NOW: Want to join our Austin team as an intern this spring? 🌸

December 1st is the application deadline! View the full descriptions and apply now at https://t.co/IM3ezkkJ1q. https://t.co/7rg2gbkU6w

The corrupt and far-right Supreme Court just gave Trump the OK to rip up Big Bend with a border wall.

No one will be safer or freer. It’s just going to destroy the nature and wildlife that we love at Big Bend.

Democrats, Republicans, Texans of all backgrounds all agree: leave Big Bend alone.

This weekend I had the honor of introducing the largest ever class of new members of the Congressional Progressive Caucus.

They are as diverse as America, but we are united in an unbreakable commitment to shake up Washington DC, root out corruption, and stand up for working https://t.co/WzNPtAgIff
Proud to stand alongside the incoming members of the Congressional Progressive Caucus. https://t.co/ViR8kRCoQQ
LIVE: CPC New Member Press Conference https://t.co/gfvvDN6cgs

Affordability.

Ending the war.

Taking on billionaires and big corporations.

Progressives are going to make sure Democrats can deliver on the promises everyone ran on. https://t.co/1eRQopOHab
Ban RSI. https://t.co/HWL4n9eO6o

Trump just promoted the man responsible for ICE shooting people on the streets.

We will fight Trump and Miller's dangerous, out of control policies at every turn.

 https://t.co/UZMeowzPAi
Elon Musk spent hundreds of millions of his own dollars in the midterm elections for Greg Abbott and Ken Paxton. It backfired on him. https://t.co/wPhMKbpyQx
Our majority next Congress is over 100 weeks long — every week we should be passing bills that lower costs and put money back in people’s pockets. https://t.co/l5kIY95qST
Yes! https://t.co/HwHu4LuLxh

Gina Hinojosa is going to transform millions of Texans’ lives for the better.

The folks working double shifts without healthcare. The students facing school closures. The families scared they could be torn to shreds by ICE.

For too long, all they’ve experienced from state government is higher bills and endless corruption. In January, they get a governor on their side.
Abolish the filibuster. https://t.co/UuuF431CEp

Parents asked Google for more control over AI in their kids’ schools. Now Google says that if a school turns off its AI, students lose Google search too. In other words, a monopoly wants to bully schools into using its products.

Google will be hearing from me, demanding answers. https://t.co/FsYYL4fdmy

AI will be the number one issue in 2028.

And anyone looking to OpenAI’s lobbyist for advice will lose. https://t.co/XxFhAVk4Hx

AI executives have spent big on Trump. Now their AI is hacking websites, including a government health database. If Trump’s DOJ looks the other way, that’s corruption, plain and simple.

I’m leading 17 members of Congress and demanding an investigation. https://t.co/neie7AjBVP

I respect Sen. Schatz, but I 100% disagree with him here.

Even if we win the midterms, Democrats have far to go to win back the trust of working people. If Democrats don't understand that, we will sleepwalk into President Vance 2028.

No one in America thinks the status quo is working. 

Voters want fighters for higher paychecks and lower prices. Next year, Democrats must pass bills powerful enough to actually tackle the cost of living crisis and root out rampant corruption. We cannot be the party of nervous lawyers who just tinker around the edges.

For more than a decade, Democrats have been known primarily as the anti-Trump Party. If we take back Congress, we have to show we're more than anti-Trump. That starts with cracking down on corporate greed to bring down the cost of health care, housing, child care, groceries, and gas. And it means doing oversight of both the Trump Administration and big corporations ripping people off. 

If Donald Trump chooses to veto our popular, pro-affordability policies, the fight is far from over. We'll run on them in 2028 and pass them in 2029.

My colleagues and I are demanding that OpenAI not fire whistleblowers and keep its most powerful models paused until there’s real oversight.

AI CEOs should also be dragged in front of Congress and asked about the risks they’re putting on us. https://t.co/2sZ4thMet9
My final conversation with Dolores Huerta happened to be captured by @MotherJones’ Tim Murphy, right after Dolores gave our airport restaurant workers a pep talk. https://t.co/nRZSgO0agX

I’m heartbroken. For decades, Dolores Huerta fought to make the world a better place for workers, women, and immigrants.

At 95 years old, Dolores would get on a red-eye flight on a moment’s notice to make it for a protest at the Capitol, or a meeting with brave Texas workers. https://t.co/TWfj9FAt3m

Last week, I joined @MehdiRHasan and @RealMoAmer in Houston for the biggest @Zeteo_News event yet!

Our message was simple: no more genocide & mass destruction. No more billionaires controlling our economy and elections.

People are demanding change. Congress needs to catch up. https://t.co/f1b8P6g665

Congratulations to the people of Brazil! 

 https://t.co/oTIBxARWm0

Brad Lander, rabbis, and other Americans were with Palestinian farmers during the annual olive harvest when they were detained by the IDF.

A clear violation of international law.

I’m glad that Brad has been released — but he should never have been detained in the first place. Everyone else needs to be released immediately.

Congress must pass the Stop the Settlements Act, make it clear that abuses like this are unacceptable, and stop funding this terror.

Mi oficina fue informada de que ICE está usando estacionamientos en Austin como bases de operación de ICE para aterrorizar a nuestra comunidad.

ICE está haciendo que Austin sea menos seguro. Niños tienen miedo de ir a la escuela, los padres tienen miedo de ir a trabajar y hasta las víctimas de delitos tienen miedo de hablar con la policía.

Hago un llamado a los dueños y operadores de estacionamientos en Austin para que no le renten ni le presten su propiedad a ICE para estos operativos.

ICE tiene que irse de Austin.

(Foto vía el periodista Mario Tapia)

My office has been notified that ICE is using parking lots in Austin as staging areas to terrorize our community.

ICE is making Austin less safe. Kids are scared to go to school, parents are scared to go to work, and crime victims are even scared to talk to police.

I am urging owners and operators of parking lots in Austin to not rent or lend your property to ICE for these operations.

ICE needs to get out of Austin.

(Photo via journalist Mario Tapia)

An airman tragically lost his life at the Alamodome last night while helping honor our military before the UTSA–Navy game. San Antonio is grieving with his family today. My prayers are with them and with everyone he served alongside.

Heidi Levine was covering the West Bank olive harvest when masked settlers viciously attacked her. 

More than 1,600 Israeli settler attacks have occurred so far this year — nearly all of them targeting Palestinians.

Enough. Congress must pass the Stop the Settlements Act to

Members of Congress came to Austin today to begin our investigation of the ICE shooting of Wilber Garcés-Pérez.

ICE has tried to avoid accountability, but Congress will use our powers to uncover the truth. https://t.co/x1a7q89LBN

LIVE: I'm leading a field hearing in Austin with @RepJayapal, @BennieGThompson, and other Democrats on ICE shootings across Texas, including the shooting of Wilber Garcés Pérez.

Texans deserve answers.

Watch: https://t.co/G2GSggzvTv

ICE shot Wilber Garcés Pérez, a DoorDash driver, in Austin. All across the state and country, Trump’s ICE is shooting innocent people and locking up kids.

It’s out of control. 

I’m holding a field hearing this week in Austin with @RepJayapal, @BennieGThompson, and other

Trump has sent ICE to arrest kids, to shoot innocent citizens, and now to raid the home of a US Congresswoman because he thinks it’ll help his party this election season.

Ilhan Omar stands up and won’t let Trump do whatever he wants to our country. It’s up to us to do the same.

More than 200,000 Texans are stuck waiting for Medicaid approval.

Republicans cut health care for millions of people and buried Texans in paperwork.
https://t.co/ioblRWFeO7

A judge ruled Trump's plan to cut FEMA in half was illegal.

But it shouldn't take a court order to keep disaster responders on the job.

I have a bill to put the fired workers back and restore the flood programs Trump gutted. https://t.co/bzgY6SpxZK

The company that locked people in small cages and called them "calming areas" is opening an ICE detention warehouse in San Antonio.

We should be closing these facilities — not building more. https://t.co/v7zQ5n5S5B

Trump and his sons quietly moved 20 billion crypto tokens into an account that lets them cash out.

Corruption, plain and simple.
https://t.co/IAJWQYLwEN

25 kids in one Texas courtroom. 15 with no lawyer. The youngest was 3.

One of them, 13-year-old Angel, broke down crying: "I have no one. I have nothing."

And it's happening to kids in immigration courts across the country. It's evil.
https://t.co/Y1wm4Ub2jG

Good news: Wilber Garces Perez finally had surgery to remove the bullet that was in his back for 11 days.

It took far too long, and it's more proof of ICE cruelty. But we kept up the pressure, and Wilber got the care he needed.

Speaking up for our neighbors works.

Outrageous. OpenAI has reportedly fired three safety researchers for sharing information with an outside AI safety group.

This looks like they're firing whistleblowers. What are they hiding?

I'll be sending OpenAI a demand for transparency. https://t.co/4NHB2PcRZJ

OpenAI's president admits his AI super PAC has become a liability. The pressure is working.

Progressives have worked hard to make LTF as toxic as AIPAC. Now one of its biggest donors is backing out. 

Democrats need to stand with the people and reject AI billionaires' money. https://t.co/IgvUkTcc7e

The fox is guarding the henhouse.

The billionaires profiting from dangerous, job-killing AI are writing the rules.

Unacceptable. https://t.co/6aKaKF6T0l

Before I got to Congress, I organized to win water breaks for Austin construction workers. Then Abbott signed a law wiping them out.

Now thousands of Texas workers are getting sick in extreme heat.

In Congress, I'm fighting so every worker in America gets water breaks, a decent

We don’t need more ways for corporations to jack up prices, and that includes Big Macs.

Surveillance pricing should be illegal across the country. I have a bill to ban it. https://t.co/BvZBi6eKXh

Trump is sitting down with AI billionaires today, including Musk, Bezos, Zuckerberg, and Huang, worth a combined $1.7 trillion.

None of them are worried about losing their jobs, freedoms, or lives because of AI.

Millions of Americans are. https://t.co/22csehHWgB

A federal judge just ruled that locking people in hot Texas prisons without AC is unconstitutional. Every unit needs to be cooled by 2029.

The state admits 20+ people died from heat in its prisons. Yet it wants to appeal the decision.

Texas should stop fighting this, and start https://t.co/b9PPhSBUkY

Republicans should haul Sam Altman before Congress, to testify under oath, today.

OpenAI’s models have now hacked real companies, hacked Australian government websites, and attempted to hack federal websites here at home.

In @SenSanders' and my new bill: no frontier AI without https://t.co/p9e2lHi3Ab

This San Antonio Express-News op-ed is right: corporations mining your personal data and supercharging it with AI to set your price is sinister.

It's why I wrote the first federal bill to ban surveillance pricing. https://t.co/nf4ooDTZaI

Trump said he’d drain the swamp.

Last night he sat Xi Jinping at a dinner table with Elon Musk, Tim Cook, Sam Altman, and other tech billionaires worth a combined $1.13 trillion.

Trump’s friends get power and access.

Working people get nothing. https://t.co/BxT3yucvNR
https://t.co/NIc1isNAsD

The movement to ban artificial superintelligence is growing.

Here are the first 10 House co-sponsors of my bill with Sen. Sanders to ban ASI.

Thank you: @RepYassAnsari @RepAOC @RepDeluzio @RepChuyGarcia @Rep_Grijalva @RepValHoyle @RepRoKhanna @RepStephenLynch @RepAnalilia

I saw Wilber in ICE detention yesterday, in a wheelchair with a bullet still in his body.

Here’s what’s next: He needs surgery. And ICE needs to cooperate with the independent investigation. https://t.co/zPVzCPd2Dl
